title: RuleCases -Case All under the engine's TEMP
how_to_read: Each attempt is one line and a `details` filename in this same directory. Open a detail file ONLY when this index points you at one -- the summaries are here so you do not have to. `caused_by` is what sent the stage back; `changed` is what the attempt then touched, counted by kind. Several attempts in a row that were caused by the same stage and changed no `src` is a loop, not progress.

open.issue: observed: C-006 stopped: Access is denied. … Remove-Item: …\tests\rules\RuleCases.ps1:859 … | Access is denied. … FAIL no folder of the run is left in the unlistable TEMP (left: fsa-engine-case-b4007dd6b1, fsa-rules-sl0981566931847) — 4 check(s) failed.

rulecases-local-root-plus-dotnet-delete: needs first: Remove the shared fsa-tests base when it is left empty (non-recursive Directory.Delete, errors swallowed), or put the run folder directly in the TEMP so no base is created, then re-run the bug test. The diagnostic variant of the first option passed it.

dotnet-delete-under-real-windows-temp: needs first: Fix (a) must clear +R on read-only files before the Delete (for example a walk with [IO.File]::SetAttributes(f, Normal)), or fall back to such a walk when Delete throws UnauthorizedAccessException. Plain Delete(path,$true) is not equivalent to Remove-Item -Force.

Run-root predicate. The proposal moved RuleCases' scratch out of any TEMP a probe cannot list. This design uses TempTree.ChooseTestsRoot's path rule, so one predicate governs TempTree, WindowCases and RuleCases, and the acceptance test keeps RuleCases' own removal under an unlistable parent in play. A reviewer may prefer the listability probe's generality.

Where the read-only fallback is proved. The proposal added a +R file to the acceptance test's stand-in. This design keeps the acceptance test byte-identical and proves the read-only, junction, already-gone and held-open shapes in a sibling AST-extraction test.

Whether the per-run root belongs in this slice at all. The proposal's own over-engineering note says the delete helper alone passes the acceptance test. The root is kept for findable killed-run leftovers (#373, Q-132) and can be dropped on its own.
Whether a failed scratch removal should fail the run (counted FAIL, exit 1) or only print a warning line.
A PowerShell mirror of ChooseTestsRoot in WindowCases (Get-CloudRigParent) versus hard-coding %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp\fsa-tests, which is the same answer under both measured TEMPs.
Stale fsa-cf-* roots in the old location. The person clears them once, versus a legacy sweep kept in exempt TempTree.cs.
